Marina Bay

Marina Bay 6

  1. Must see · Marina Bay

    Gardens by the Bay

    Waterfront nature park with the Supertree Grove, Cloud Forest & Flower Dome; over 1.5 million plants.

    Look for Garden

    18 Marina Gardens Drive, Marina Bay

    Recommended by Visit Singapore (Singapore Tourism Board), Wikipedia (English)

  2. Must see · Marina Bay

    Marina Bay Sands SkyPark Observation Deck

    The 57th-storey deck atop Marina Bay Sands' three towers, with panoramic skyline views over the bay.

    Look for Landmark

    10 Bayfront Avenue, Marina Bay

    Recommended by Marina Bay Sands (official), The Honeycombers Singapore

  3. Must see · Marina Bay

    Merlion Park

    Home of the 8.6 m Merlion, Singapore's lion-headed, fish-bodied national symbol, spouting into the bay.

    Look for Landmark

    1 Fullerton Road, Marina Bay

    Recommended by Visit Singapore (Singapore Tourism Board), Wikipedia (English)

  4. Worth the detour · Marina Bay

    ArtScience Museum

    Lotus-shaped museum at Marina Bay Sands; home to the teamLab 'Future World' digital art gallery.

    Look for Museum

    6 Bayfront Avenue, Marina Bay

    Recommended by Marina Bay Sands (official), Wikipedia (English)

  5. Worth the detour · Marina Bay

    Singapore Flyer

    A 165 m observation wheel over Marina Bay with views to the city, the Straits and beyond.

    Look for Landmark

    30 Raffles Avenue, Marina Bay

    Recommended by Visit Singapore (Singapore Tourism Board), Wikipedia (English)

  6. Worth the detour · Marina Bay

    Esplanade – Theatres on the Bay

    The 'durian' performing-arts centre on the bayfront, a defining piece of the skyline.

    Look for Landmark

    1 Esplanade Drive, Marina Bay

    Recommended by Wikipedia (English), Visit Singapore (Singapore Tourism Board)
